_about: Unit rules the master tables do not hold, read by hand from the game's Lua (dlc/<Region>/additional_lua/unit/<unit id>.lua). Keyed by unitsv2 base. build_battle_sim.py copies them into battle_sim.json 'o'; js/battle-engine.js runs them. Effects use the battle_sim effect layout: [type, target, seconds, value, chance, icon, script, mode, animation, sv1, sv2, sv3, group, priority, buff_type]. Keys starting with _ are notes and are not exported.

_notes: takeSkill index 5 without buff 1077772121: start UBW (BUFF_BOX_LIST[1]: type 33, value 100, 180 s); no restart when used again (else branch only adds the final-arts flag)
takeSkill index 5 with the buff: animation skill5_2 and superSkillFLG -> update adds BUFF_BOX_LIST[8] ATK +200 (group 1006, priority 200) and [9] DMG +200 (group 1029, priority 200), 35 s
update while the buff is on: getBurstSkill2():setDamageRate(default x 2) = True Arts damage x2

level >= 90 while the buff is on: orbit sword every orbitTime 8 s, setActiveSkill(5), damage rate offset orbitDamage/skill5Damage = 100/1700 of the Super Arts rate (1700) = 100x = 10000 %, break rate 0; teamAddBuff BUFF_BOX_LIST[6] type 21 -30 for 1 s every frame
level >= 90 when UBW starts: antiBadCondition(54) and (59) = types 54/103 and 59/108 value 100 for 180 s; BUFF_BOX_LIST[7] type 27 -100 for 180 s
Super Arts damage only when used during UBW: skill text; the Lua swaps the animation to skill5_2, which carries the hits
